resources.string: Here are the changes in this version. Your settings are preserved.
New terminal page to the left of home: swipe right, type after your user@device prompt and choose a result.
Search apps, optional contacts, noduS settings and the web. Open camera or apps and request supported device actions locally.
Export and import configuration ZIPs, including favourites, both header profiles and your imported font. Restore requires confirmation.
More compact switches, with a smaller visual track and an accessible touch area. SSH and AI remain future work.
